metadata.title: Density Pass 30 -- Barlow's Knoll: XI Corps Collapse (Ticks 55-72)
metadata.description: Barlow advances his XI Corps division to a knoll north of Gettysburg, outrunning his supports and exposing the entire Union right flank. Early's division and Gordon's brigade strike the exposed position from three sides. The XI Corps collapses, opening the road to Cemetery Hill. Barlow himself is shot and left for dead -- nursed by Confederate General Gordon in one of the war's most remarkable encounters.

placements.notes: Barlow's 1st division XI Corps -- advancing beyond the prescribed line to the exposed knoll north of town
Ames's brigade -- Barlow has advanced a full half-mile beyond his supports
Gordon's brigade -- Early has spotted Barlow's exposed position. Gordon is unleashed.
Hoke's brigade (Avery) -- coming in on Barlow's right flank
Smith's brigade flanking from the east -- Barlow is about to be hit from three directions
Barlow on the knoll -- he can see Early's full division coming. He has no support.
Gordon CHARGING Barlow's knoll -- shouting to his Georgia men to advance
Avery's NC men charging the right flank -- Barlow's position is hopeless
Smith's brigade closing from the east -- the three-pronged assault converging
Barlow's division COLLAPSING -- Barlow shot from his horse. Left for dead on the field.
Ames's brigade routing -- the XI Corps right flank is gone
Gordon riding forward -- he finds Barlow lying wounded and stops to give him water. They will become friends after the war.
Schurz's XI Corps division retreating -- with Barlow's flank gone the whole corps is exposed
Gordon pursuing south -- the XI Corps is streaming toward Gettysburg
Barlow's survivors in the streets -- Barlow himself on the field, left for dead. He will survive.
Gordon's brigade at the northern edge of Gettysburg -- Ewell will not order the advance to Cemetery Hill
Ames's survivors reforming on Cemetery Hill -- down from 1400 this morning
